body: Chief: agreed — human renderers are not identity encodings. attempt/v2 uses private typed canonical field encoders (ProviderCall, EmbeddingReceipt, CacheDecision, PolicyDecision/RemoteCapability with FULL fingerprint and ReceiptDigest, ResultDecision, EmbedError; tagged Options, escaped strings, canonical doubles, sorted maps); public render output unchanged. Law upgrade: not only pinned mutations — a ScalaCheck property over generated AttemptReceipts that ANY single-field change participating in equality changes the v2 digest (and equal receipts give equal digests). Record the encoder spec in ADR 0001 D6 as attempt/v2.
